notes: DCA prospective need was 223; Borough revised to 210 per Resolution #55-2025 (Jan 27, 2025) based on VLA showing some DCA-identified parcels were not developable. Present need 16 accepted. VLA reveals zero capacity for new construction on vacant land; however two redevelopment projects generate 21 RDP: Parker 2 (completed 2023, 61-62 units, 9 affordable) and Williams Center Redevelopment Area (80 units planned, 15% set-aside = 12 affordable units). Total Fourth Round unmet need = 189. Combined with prior round unmet need (488), total unmet need = 677 units. Borough has mandatory set-aside ordinance (15% rental, 20% for-sale for 3+ new residential units). Present need addressed via Bergen County Rehabilitation Program + supplemental municipal rehab program. Kip Avenue Redevelopment Area (Block 74, Lots 17, 18, 18.01) planned as 100% affordable project and excluded from VLA. Prepared by Neglia Engineering. Docket BER-L-000660-25, filed 06/24/2025.

sources.title: Rutherford Borough Fourth Round Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (RutherfordHEFSP2.pdf)
sources.excerpt: The Borough of Rutherford has agreed to a Prospective Need Obligation of 210 units pursuant to Resolution #55-2025 ... The Parker 2 was not included in the Third Round Housing Element and Fair Share Plan. The multi-family project was approved and constructed and resulted in 62 units inclusive of 9 affordable units. In addition, the Borough has designated the Williams Center as an Area in Need of Redevelopment. The Plan results in 80 multi-family units with a maximum set aside of 15%. The Williams Center project will generate an additional 6 affordable units. Therefore, the Borough of Rutherford has an RDP of 21 units.
